coordinateNote: Coordinates verified against official venue pages, Tabelog, the GSI address-search API, and the saved-place export. Floor and building data added from official sources. Some pins are address-level approximations. check opening hours and reservations directly with each bar.

bars.name: Apollo Bar Ginza
bars.address: B1F MEIKO Building, 8-2-15 Ginza, Chuo-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Shimbashi (JR / Tokyo Metro) — 5 min walk
bars.description: A Ginza cocktail bar with a modern, relaxed feel compared to the old-school counters nearby. Good for a long evening that starts here and moves.

bars.name: Star Bar Ginza
bars.address: B1F MODERNS GINZA, 1-5-13 Ginza, Chuo-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Ginza (Tokyo Metro Ginza/Marunouchi/Hibiya) — 3 min walk
bars.description: One of Ginza's most respected cocktail bars. A short counter, ice carved by hand, and drinks built with a precision that makes the room go quiet. The kind of place where you order one thing and stay for three.

bars.name: Lamp Bar
bars.address: 4F Wakamatsu Building, 6-6-19 Ginza, Chuo-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Ginza (Tokyo Metro Ginza/Marunouchi/Hibiya) — 4 min walk
bars.description: A warm, lamplit Ginza counter bar. Quiet, intimate, and the kind of place where the bartender remembers what you drank last time.

bars.name: NOCTURNE
aliases: オーセンティックバー Nocturne
bars.address: 3F Ryushin Building, 8-7-9 Ginza, Chuo-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Shimbashi (JR / Tokyo Metro) — 5 min walk
bars.description: An authentic bar on the 3rd floor of the Ryushin Building in Ginza, near Shimbashi. A quiet counter with a master who knows his cocktails and his regulars. The kind of Ginza bar where the elevator entrance is hard to find. that is the point.

bars.name: The Pizza Bar On 38th
aliases: ザ ピザバー オン 38th
bars.address: 38F Mandarin Oriental Tokyo, 2-1-1 Nihonbashi Muromachi, Chuo-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Mitsukoshimae (Tokyo Metro Ginza/Hanzomon) — 2 min walk
bars.description: A pizza bar on the 38th floor of the Mandarin Oriental. Yes, pizza. wood-fired, counter seating, and a view that rivals New York Bar's. Expensive, and the pizza is better than it has any right to be at that altitude.

bars.name: New York Bar
bars.address: Park Hyatt Tokyo, 52F, 3-7-1-2 Nishishinjuku, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Shinjuku (JR / Tokyo Metro / Odakyu / Keio) — 10 min walk
bars.description: The bar from Lost in Translation. Fifty-second floor of the Park Hyatt, floor-to-ceiling windows, a live jazz trio, and a whisky list that runs deep. Expensive, and worth it once. Go early on a weeknight for a seat by the window.

bars.name: Bar Cocktailbook Shinjuku
aliases: バー カクテルブック 新宿
bars.address: 2F Plaza Nishishinjuku, 7-5-5 Nishishinjuku, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Shinjuku (JR / Tokyo Metro / Odakyu / Keio) — 5 min walk
bars.description: A Shinjuku cocktail bar with a bookshelf of cocktail recipes behind the counter. The bartender will make you something off the page if you ask. A quieter alternative to the Ginza circuit.

bars.name: KAKURETAI
bars.address: B1F Nakabayashi Building, 1-2 Arakicho, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Yotsuya-Sanchome (Tokyo Metro Marunouchi) — 2 min walk
bars.description: A hidden speakeasy in Arakicho, down an unmarked basement entrance. Owner Yuta crafts seasonal cocktails with Japanese fruits. the strawberry margarita and Earl Grey tea sake are standouts. Cheese-and-mouse decor, J-Pop playlists, sometimes a live DJ. A cozy hideout that treats regulars and first-timers the same. Closed weekends.

bars.name: Bar rest
bars.address: 3F Dai-san Hirasawa Building, 2-46-7 Kabukicho, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Shinjuku (JR / Tokyo Metro / Odakyu / Keio) — 5 min walk
bars.description: A snack bar on the 3rd floor of the Dai-san Hirasawa Building in Kabukicho, one minute from Seibu-Shinjuku station. A hidden counter with a view of the trains rolling past the Shinjuku skyline. The master keeps a quiet room above the noise below.

bars.name: SAKE MARKET Shinjuku
bars.address: 6F Shinjuku Watassei-Tama Building, 3-9-9 Shinjuku, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Shinjuku (JR / Tokyo Metro / Odakyu / Keio) — 3 min walk
bars.description: A sake bar in Shinjuku with a rotating selection by the glass. Good for a tasting flight before moving on to dinner.

bars.name: a BAR Sleeping Tales
aliases: ア バー スリーピング テイルズ
bars.address: B1F (right door) Towa Shinjuku Gyoen Co-op II, 2-1-14 Shinjuku, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Shinjuku (JR / Tokyo Metro / Odakyu / Keio) — 5 min walk
bars.description: A Shinjuku bar with a storybook name. A quiet counter for a late drink, away from the Kabukicho noise.

bars.name: Golden Gai: Happy, BAR COO & OPEN BOOK
aliases: ハッピー ロッキンソールバー
bars.address: 1-1-6 to 1-1-8 Kabukicho, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Shinjuku (JR / Tokyo Metro / Toei) — 5 min walk
bars.description: Three bars in Shinjuku Golden Gai, the dense cluster of 200-plus tiny drinking dens off Kabukicho. each on a different floor of the same narrow alley. Happy (Rockin' Soul Bar) is up on the 3rd floor of the Maruha Building at 1-1-7. a soul-and-rock counter with a 4.8 rating. BAR COO (バー 空) is at street level (1F) at 1-1-8, on Golden Gai 3rd street. six seats, drinks and snacks at the owner's discretion, like drinking in a friend's kitchen. OPEN BOOK is on Golden Gai 5th street at 1-1-6, ground floor, no signboard. a lemon sour bar founded in 2015, shelves lined with books inherited from the owner's grandfather, poet Tanaka Kojimasa. Pick any of the three, or bar-hop between them.

subvenues.name: Happy (Rockin' Soul Bar)
subvenues.description: A soul-and-rock counter bar on the 3rd floor of the Maruha Building. 4.8 rating. Go up the stairs.

subvenues.name: BAR COO
subvenues.description: A six-seat casual bar on Golden Gai 3rd street. Drinks and snacks at the owner's discretion. like drinking in a friend's kitchen.

subvenues.name: OPEN BOOK
subvenues.description: A lemon sour bar on Golden Gai 5th street, founded in 2015. No signboard. third door from the outside. Shelves lined with books inherited from the owner's grandfather, poet Tanaka Kojimasa.

bars.name: FIGHTCLUB Shibuya
bars.address: 1F Towa Dogenzaka Building, 2-27-2 Dogenzaka, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Shibuya (JR / Tokyo Metro / Tokyu / Keio Inokashira) — 3 min walk
bars.description: A kickboxing gym and bar on Dogenzaka in Shibuya. Fight training upstairs, drinks after. Not a cocktail bar. a place where the crowd came to hit things and then order a round. Loud, young, and exactly what the name says.

bars.name: JANAI COFFEE
bars.address: B1F Yamanen Building, 2-3-13 Ebisuminami, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Ebisu (JR Yamanote / Tokyo Metro Hibiya) — 3 min walk
bars.description: It is called a coffee shop. It is not a coffee shop. JANAI means 'not this'. the door is a speakeasy entrance, and what is behind it is a bar. Go down the stairs, find the door, and order a drink. The coffee is a cover story.

bars.name: A10
bars.address: B1F Bios Building, 1-12-11 Ebisunishi, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Ebisu (JR Yamanote / Tokyo Metro Hibiya) — 3 min walk
bars.description: An Ebisu bar around the corner from JANAI. Small, focused, and easy to miss if you are not looking for it.

bars.name: BUNDAN Coffee & Beer
bars.address: Inside the Museum of Modern Japanese Literature, 4-3-55 Komaba, Meguro-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Komaba-Todaimae (Keio Inokashira) — 3 min walk
bars.description: A literary cafe and bar inside the Museum of Modern Japanese Literature in Komaba. Coffee by day, beer and wine by evening, and books on every wall. The name means 'passing along a story.' A quiet stop between the museum and the park.

bars.name: Bar sawa
bars.address: 1F Forum Nakameguro, 1-6-7 Higashiyama, Meguro-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Nakameguro (Tokyo Metro Hibiya) — 5 min walk
bars.description: A bar in Higashiyama, the quiet side of Nakameguro. A counter spot for a drink before or after dinner in the neighborhood.

bars.name: No Room For Squares
aliases: ノー・ルーム・フォー・スクエアーズ
bars.address: 4F Housing Kitazawa Building II, 2-1-7 Kitazawa, Setagaya-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Shimokitazawa (Odakyu / Keio Inokashira) — 3 min walk
bars.description: A jazz bar in Shimokitazawa. The name is a Mingus reference. Vinyl on the turntable, a small room, and a crowd that came for the music. Check the schedule.

bars.name: Gen Yamamoto
bars.address: 1F Anniversary Building, 1-6-4 Azabujuban, Minato-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Azabujuban (Toei Oedo) — 3 min walk
bars.description: A reservation-only cocktail bar in Azabujuban. One bartender, a short counter, and a tasting-menu-style flight of seasonal cocktails built on Japanese ingredients. Sit, watch, do not rush.

bars.name: Bar Centifolia
aliases: バー センティフォリア
bars.address: 6F La Muse Azabujuban Building, 1-6-5 Azabujuban, Minato-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Azabujuban (Toei Oedo) — 3 min walk
bars.description: An Azabujuban bar near Gen Yamamoto. A quieter, older-school counter for a late drink in the neighborhood.

bars.name: Rokusan Angel (Burlesque Tokyo)
bars.address: B2F Roppongi Nittaku Building, 3-8-15 Roppongi, Minato-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Roppongi (Toei Oedo / Tokyo Metro Hibiya) — 5 min walk
bars.description: A Roppongi burlesque bar. Live performances, cocktails, and a stage that is close enough to touch. Book ahead.

bars.name: BAR &UNDER
aliases: バー アンドアンダー
bars.address: B1F Sotokanda Kanemura Building, 2-6-4 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Akihabara (JR / Tokyo Metro Hibiya) — 5 min walk
bars.description: A basement bar in Kanda, near Akihabara. The name tells you where to look. go down. A good late-night stop in a neighborhood that shuts early.

bars.name: NARU Jazz Livehouse
bars.address: B1 Jujiya Building, 2-1 Kanda Surugadai, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo 101-0062
bars.station: Ochanomizu (JR Chuo/Sobu, Tokyo Metro Marunouchi) — 1 min walk
bars.description: A long-running jazz livehouse in Ochanomizu, open since 1969. Intimate tables around a grand piano, nightly sets from working Tokyo musicians, and a kitchen that turns out a real dinner. Cover charge around ¥2,500 plus drinks.

bars.name: Game Bar A-Button
aliases: ゲームバー エーボタン
bars.address: 1F Dai-5 Mitsumasa Building, 1-13-9 Taito, Taito-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Inaricho (Tokyo Metro Ginza) — 4 min walk
bars.description: A game bar in Taito. Retro consoles behind the counter, drinks in front, and you can borrow a controller. A good stop if you want a drink and a round of something old.

bars.name: BAR Willow's
bars.address: 6F-E, 88 Building, 2-1-3 Ueno, Taito-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Okachimachi (JR) — 3 min walk; Ueno-Hirokoji (Tokyo Metro Ginza) — 1 min walk
bars.description: A bar on the 6th floor of the 88 Building in Ueno. Antique chairs, a long cocktail and whisky list, and a counter that welcomes first-timers. The kind of hidden-floor Tokyo bar you have to know the elevator for.

bars.name: Rock Bar Sakebi
aliases: ロックバー さけび
bars.address: 1F, 2-16-11 Negishi, Taito-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Nippori (JR Yamanote / Keisei) — 8 min walk
bars.description: A rock bar in Negishi, north of Ueno. Loud music, strong drinks, and a crowd that came for both. Not the place for a quiet conversation.

bars.name: The TRAD whisky & cocktails
bars.address: 1F Fukase Building, 3-43-9 Yushima, Bunkyo-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Ueno-Hirokoji (Tokyo Metro Ginza) — 3 min walk
bars.description: A whisky and cocktail bar in Yushima, between Ueno and Okachimachi. The name says what it is. A solid counter, a deep whisky shelf, and no pretense.

bars.name: Eigakan Jazz
bars.address: B1F, 5-33-19 Hakusan, Bunkyo-ku, Tokyo 112-0001
bars.station: Hakusan (Toei Mita Line A3) — 1 min walk
bars.description: A jazz kissa in Hakusan, down a narrow staircase from street level. The name means 'cinema.' Vinyl on the turntable, dim light below ground, and a room that has been spinning records for decades. Cash only. Closed Sundays, Mondays, and holidays.

bars.name: Shooting Bar EA
aliases: シューティングバー イーエー
bars.address: 2F Sawada Building, 1-5-5 Gotenyama, Musashino, Tokyo
bars.station: Kichijoji (JR Chuo / Keio Inokashira) — 8 min walk
bars.description: A shooting bar in Kichijoji, in the city of Musashino west of the 23 wards. Airsoft rifles, a target range, and drinks. Not a cocktail bar, but a uniquely Tokyo evening out. reachable on the Chuo line from Shinjuku in about 20 minutes.

bars.name: SAKEBARO Aoyama
bars.address: 1F MD Aoyama, 2-10-8 Minami-Aoyama, Minato-ku, Tokyo 107-0062
bars.station: Omotesando (Tokyo Metro Ginza/Hanzomon/Chiyoda) — 8 min walk
bars.description: The one that is not like the others. A members-only sake club in Minami-Aoyama. an extension of the original Naka-Meguro SAKEBARO. A tin cube counter, an auto-playing piano, LED light that shifts from deep blue to red. A curated cellar of rare and seasonal brews, and staff who can tell you the brewery, the yeast strain, and the rice polish rate for every pour. Everything else on this map you can walk into. This one you have to be let into.
bars.note: Reservation or membership required. Arrange access well before you travel.
